declare
 ps_status VARCHAR2(2);

 v_local_time date;
begin
 if :ctrl_blk.pick_slip_id is not null
 then
 begin
 select pick_slip_status, 
 decode(substr(picked_by,1,4),'OPS$',substr(picked_by,5),picked_by),
 insert_date into
 ps_status, :user, v_local_idate --:I_date
 from pick_slips
 where
 pick_slip_id = :ctrl_blk.pick_slip_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error_dist('3300');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 if :global.is_timezone_enabled = 'Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_local_idate,v_local_time);
 :I_date := v_local_time;
 else
 :I_date := v_local_idate;
 end if; 
 
 if ps_status != 'RP'
 then
 show_error_dist('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Item.Name: PRODUCT_CODE
Item.Hint: Enter value for product code or use [LISTVAL]

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 up_cnt number;
 exp_cnt number;
 v_local_time date;
begin
 up_cnt := 0;
 exp_cnt := 0;
 nullchk;
 check_package_Failure;

--Check in case of manual entry if the length of product code is correct
 IF :s_product_code = 'M' THEN
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' AND NVL(length(:ctrl_blk_1.product_code), 0) != 8 THEN
 show_error_dist('9803');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'C' AND NVL(length(:ctrl_blk_1.product_code), 0) != 5 THEN
 show_error_dist('9804');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 begin
 select 'x' into :global.v_x 
 from vserv_products
 where product_code = substr(:ctrl_blk_1.product_code,1,5)
 and unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme 
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate + 365);
 erase(:global.v_x);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0309');
 check_package_failure;
 end ;
 begin
 select count(*) into up_cnt from pick_slip_products
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code and
 product_status = 'RP' and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 if up_cnt = 0
 then
 show_error_dist('1717');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 
 
 if :global.is_timezone_enabled ='Y' then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if; 
 
 
 
 
 select count(*) into exp_cnt 
 from pick_slip_products
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code and
 exp_date <= v_local_time and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 if exp_cnt > 0
 then
 message('Warn: Product has already expired');
-- show_error_dist('3701');
-- check_package_failure;
 end if;

--Modified for both schemes to coexist
 select distinct ps.product_code, vs.product_desc,
 inv_product_type into
 :ctrl_blk_1.product_code, :s_product_code_desc, :s_product_type
 from pick_slip_products ps,
 vserv_products vs
 where ps.unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 ps.product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code and
 vs.product_code = substr(:ctrl_blk_1.product_code,1,5) and
 vs.unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme AND
 product_status = 'RP' and
 ps.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 sysdate between vs.eff_date and nvl(vs.term_date,sysdate + 365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_product_code_desc := '';
 show_error_dist('5305');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'C' THEN
 begin
 select max(aliquot) into :ctrl_blk_1.s_aliquot
 from
 pick_slip_products where
 unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id; /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_aliquot := '';
 show_error_dist('5305');
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_aliquot := '1';
 when OTHERS
 then
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_aliquot := '1';
 end;
 END IF;
end;

Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 aq_cnt number;
 temp_wh varchar2(1); 
 v_local_edate date;
 v_local_time date;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 aq_cnt := 0;
 begin
 select count(*) into aq_cnt from pick_slip_products
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code and
 aliquot = :ctrl_blk_1.s_aliquot and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if aq_cnt = 0
 then
 show_error_dist('0313');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

--Modified for both schemes to coexist
 select distinct ps.exp_date, ps.blood_type,
 substr(vs.abo_desc,1,6),
 ps.pick_slip_id
 into v_local_edate, --:ctrl_blk_1.exp_date,
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_blood_type,
 :ctrl_blk_1.blood_type,
 :ctrl_blk_1.pick_slip_id
 from pick_slip_products ps,
 vserv_abo vs
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code and
 chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id and
 aliquot = :s_aliquot and
 product_status = 'RP' and
 vs.abo_code = ps.blood_type
 AND vs.unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 previous_item;
 END IF;
 show_error_dist('5002');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 
 /*if :global.is_timezone_enabled ='Y' then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_local_edate,v_local_time);
 :ctrl_blk_1.exp_date := v_local_time;
 else
 :ctrl_blk_1.exp_date := v_local_edate;
 end if;
 */
 :ctrl_blk_1.exp_date := v_local_edate;
 
 begin
 select nvl(inventory_class,'RE'), nvl(warehouse_id,:GLOBAL.warehouse)
 into :s_inventory_class, temp_wh
 from active_products
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id and
 unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code and
 aliquot = :ctrl_blk_1.s_aliquot;
 IF temp_wh != :GLOBAL.warehouse
 THEN 
 show_error_dist('9929');
 END IF;
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 :s_inventory_class := 'RE';
 end;
--Since this is the last navigable field in this form
--taking the cursor back to product code in case of code 128
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 previous_item;
 END IF;
end;

begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 execute_trigger('post_location');
 check_package_failure;
 --
 -- Default device
 --
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'S_DEVICE_NUMBER', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('S_DEVICE_NUMBER',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'S_DEVICE_NUMBER', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 begin
 NEXT_ITEM;
 select p.device_number
 into :s_device_number
 from product_storage p, storage_devices d
 where p.chapter_id = :loca_0.chapter_id
 and p.warehouse_id = :s_warehouse_id
 and p.product_type = :loca_0.product_type
 and sysdate between p.effective_date
 and nvl(p.term_date,sysdate)
 and d.chapter_id = p.chapter_id
 and d.warehouse_id = p.warehouse_id
 and d.device_type = p.device_type
 and d.device_number = p.device_number
 and sysdate between d.effective_date
 and nvl(d.term_date,sysdate);
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'S_DEVICE_NUMBER', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0359');
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 if substr(:GLOBAL.save_location,13) =
 :loca_0.storage_class||
 :loca_0.product_type||
 :loca_0.blood_type
 and substr(:GLOBAL.save_location,1,1) =
 :s_warehouse_id
 then
 :s_device_number := substr(:GLOBAL.save_location,3,2);
 else
 :s_device_number := '';
 end if;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
begin
 if :m_tray_id != 'NONE'
 then
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select 'x'
 into :GLOBAL.x
 from trays
 where chapter_id = :loca_0.chapter_id
 and tray_number = :m_tray_id
 and sysdate between effective_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0341');
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_v_unit_id varchar2(17) := ltrim(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id) ||
 ltrim(lpad(to_char(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year),2,'0')) ||
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 temp_v_unit_serial_no varchar2(11) := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no ; 
 temp_v_out_unit_id varchar2(15) := null;
 temp_v_out_chk_digit varchar2(2) := null; 
BEGIN
 default_value(NULL,'GLOBAL.unit_serial_no') ; 
 IF (NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','10') or :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL) 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NULL
 THEN
 -- Assume it to be a CODABAR unit.
 IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF temp_v_unit_serial_no = :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no THEN
 Validate_Unit_Scan_Codabar(temp_v_unit_id,'M','C',temp_v_out_unit_id);
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_v_out_unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL; 
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 :GLOBAL.coll_id := null;
 :GLOBAL.coll_year := null;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := null;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left); 
 ELSE
 IF NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) != 
 NVL(length(:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no), 0) THEN
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := ''; 
 show_error_dist('0049');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := ''; 
 show_error_dist('0045');
 check_package_failure;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id := NULL; 
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 message('Please re-enter unit ID.',NO_ACKNOWLEDGE); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSIF NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','9','10','11') 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NOT NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF nvl(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_type,'X') = 'I' or NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) > 7 THEN
 show_error_dist('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 go_item('user_response.user_response'); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE 
 --Check for Multiple Codabar / Code 128 Records
 /*IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NULL or
 (:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL AND
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no != :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no) 
 THEN
 check_multiple_units(temp_v_unit_id,:global.chapter_id );
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;*/ 
 Validate_unit_scan_Code128(temp_v_unit_id,'M','I',temp_v_out_unit_id,temp_v_out_chk_digit); 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := null;
 IF temp_v_out_chk_digit = '-*' THEN
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := temp_v_out_chk_digit;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := substr(temp_v_unit_id,1,13);
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 -- go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 ELSE
 show_error_dist('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
END;

PROCEDURE empty_box IS
 temp_c_box_id varchar2(10);
 temp_all_unit number := 0;
BEGIN
 begin

 from pick_slip_products psps
 where pick_slip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.pick_slip_id and

Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_code number;
 temp_msg VARCHAR2(80);
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error_dist('0213');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error_dist('0214');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error_dist('0216');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error_dist('0204');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error_dist('0217');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error_dist('0218');
 elsif error_code = 40209 -- invalid entry format
 then
 show_error_dist('0246');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error_dist('0000');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0601');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026,0)
 then
 declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(20);
 begin
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2))='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error_dist('0251',disp_format_mask);
 show_error_dist('0251',GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 end;
 elsif error_code = 50025 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0509');
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error_dist('0220');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error_dist('0331');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;
 else -- unhandled Forms errors
 message('FRMS ' || to_char(error_code) || ':' || error_text);
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
end;
